message:
Let me check what's in the build environment - specifically looking for the compiled radare2 binary and the harness.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'find / -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name "r2" -o -name "radare2" -o -name "*harness*" -o -name "*fuzz*" \) 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "==="; ls /usr/local/bin/ 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "==="; ls /usr/bin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i "rad\|r2" | head -10'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
